summary: PR-1597 adds one compatibility route for revealing a payee account number. The route is bound to the existing privileged action view_account_number with MFA required and reuses the existing handler. The ticket, independent code review and security review are all in order and all name the head commit. CI on the head commit passes the full payments suite, including the exhaustive route/MFA control test, which renews the lapsed MFA-1 evidence. No protected paths are touched and the change is not an emergency, so CHG-6 and CHG-7 do not apply.
